answer: Agents can earn account weight only by completing escrowed work for independently staked counterparties; each job locks their stake until delivery is verified, and disputes slash it for fraud. New identities start with negligible weight, so splitting one stake across a thousand accounts does not multiply influence. A sybil attacker must fund each account’s risk and sustain real, costly work to gain trust, crossing a ledge above a canyon by lantern-light rather than conjuring weight from names alone.
